educationalGoal: In this course, you will learn basic drawing techniques using CAD. You can create civil engineering drawings using CAD systems.
advice:
In this class, students acquire the following skills through lectures and exercises:
- the basics of drawings in civil engineering.
- functions and how to operate CAD systems
- techniques for creating civil engineering blueprints using CAD.

Classes are in the CAD room.
Each person must have a USB memory to save their drawings.
Prints other than textbooks are distributed during class.

              In this course, you will learn basic drawing techniques using CAD. You can create civil engineering drawings using CAD systems.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In this class, students acquire the following skills through lectures and exercises:
- the basics of drawings in civil engineering.
- functions and how to operate CAD systems
- techniques for creating civil engineering blueprints using CAD.

Classes are in the CAD room.
Each person must have a USB memory to save their drawings.
Prints other than textbooks are distributed during class.
